assertion.text: Erdős Problem #624: declared status 'open'. Formalized: yes. Let $X$ be a finite set of size $n$ and $H(n)$ be such that there is a function $f:\{A : A\subseteq X\}\to X$ so that for every $Y\subseteq X$ with $\lvert Y\rvert \geq H(n)$ we have\[\{ f(A) : A\subseteq Y\}=X.\]Prove that\[H(n)-\log_2 n \to \infty.\] Prize: no. Tags: combinatorics.
